m.d: An over in a cricket match is six balls bowled from one end.
m.e: The captain told me I would have to bowl the next over.

m.d: Something is over when it has finished, usually referring to an event.
m.e: When the movie was over we left the movie theater.

m.d: In a location above something.
m.e: He stepped over the dog.

m.d: From one side to the other.
m.e: They went over the bridge.

m.d: A number divided by another.
m.e: Eight over two is four.

m.d: If you overnight somewhere, you spend the night there.
m.e: I overnighted at my friend's house after my home was broken into.

m.d: Period from midnight to dawn.
m.e: She went on an overnight trip to visit her mother.

m.d: An oven is for cooking food. It's hot and people put food inside it.
m.e: Leave the cake in the oven for thirty minutes.

m.d: To overwhelm, especially with emotion.
m.e: I was overcome with anger.

m.d: To surmount.
m.e: She overcame all obstacles.

m.d: To win a battle or other contest.
m.e: We will overcome our enemies.

m.d: If something is overseas, it is in a different country, usually across the ocean.
m.e: After university she went overseas to teach.

m.d: The overseas markets, students, etc. are in or from a different country, usually across an ocean.
m.e: Wang is an overseas student from China.

m.d: If evidence or numbers are overwhelming they are far more than needed.
m.e: The police believed their evidence against Curtis was overwhelming.

m.d: If you feel that something is overwhelming you feel that it is too much for you.
m.e: Parts of this job are probably very overwhelming for him.

m.d: An overtime is an extra period of time that is played when two teams end regulation (the normal number of periods) tied.
m.e: With Boston and Miami tied at 86, we're going into overtime!

m.d: In business, overtime is the time a person is paid to work that is beyond what they normally work.
m.e: The boss paid Jerry overtime to work a night shift at the warehouse

m.d: If someone or something goes overboard, it goes over the side of a boat.
m.e: When they threw the cut fish overboard, the sharks attacked.

m.d: An overall is a large, loose protective coat.
Overalls are pants with a front that comes up to your chest and straps over your shoulders.
Overalls are a loose protective trouser and shirt in one.
An overall effect, strategy, picture, etc., is one that covers everything but may not go into detail.
m.e: The play has many Christian elements, but the overall effect is not necessarily Christian.

m.d: If you look at something overall, you look at the whole of it.
m.e: Despite losing a few games, the team achieved greater successes overall than in previous years.

m.d: above your head; in the sky
An overdose is an excessive and dangerous dose of a drug.
If you overdose on a drug, you take too many doses of it.
An override is a device that is used to suspend an automatic function on a machine.
If you override a decision, you use your authority to reject or cancel it.
m.e: The Congress promptly overrode the president's veto, passing the bill into law.

m.d: If you override a machine, you interrupt its automatic function so as to take manual control.
If something is overdue, it is has past a deadline for it to be done.
Overly means excessively; too much.
m.e: Parents can be overly protective of their children.

m.d: When something is overlooked, it is not noticed or is missed out.
If you overlook something, you don't notice it, or you don't understand its importance.
m.e: It's easy to overlook the fact that there are other problems.

m.d: To overlook something, you look down upon it from a place that is higher up.
m.e: You can overlook the valley from the hill.

m.d: If you overdo something, you do too much of it.
An overthrow is the removal of a ruler or government by force.
If you overthrow someone, you remove them from power with force.
To load many items in something that it exceeds the limit.
m.e: The lift was too overloaded that it refused to close the doors until someone got out of it.

m.d: An oversight is something that someone does by mistake, without seeing that they are doing it.
m.e: He didn't thank me, but I'm sure that was just an oversight.

m.d: Oversight is the action of watching and making sure people do things right.
m.e: We have many ordinary workers, and a manager for oversight.

m.d: On Wikipedia, oversight is deleting pages or parts of pages so that not even administrators can see the part that was deleted.
m.e: I put my email address on Wikipedia by mistake, but I asked for oversight so that no one would see it.

m.d: A shape that looks like an egg.
A building that is the shape of an oval.
An overrun is an instance of overrunning.
If A overruns B, A occupies B in a large number.
m.e: Times Square has been overrun by tourists.

m.d: If something overruns, it continues beyond its allowed time or cost.
If something is overweight, it weighs above what is required or allowed.
m.e: The luggage is overweight, please remove things that are not needed from it.

m.d: To weigh down: to put too heavy a burden on.
m.e: He toppled back like an overweighted mannequin.

m.d: If a person is overweight, they are above a weight that is considered normal or desirable.
m.e: He used to be very overweight.

m.d: If a vehicle is overweight, it weighs more than what is allowed for safety commerce.
If you oversee a person, you supervise the actions of them.
To overtake is to catch up to and then pass or do better than something.
m.e: He had to really increase his speed to overtake her car on the freeway.

m.d: If something overtakes you, you are not ready, you are surprised, and overwhelmed by it.
m.e: The government's reforms were overtaken by the mass demonstrations which called for big changes in the laws.

m.d: If you overhear something, you hear things which are not meant for you (or which you should not hear).
m.e: I overheard a conversation between David and his friends that they are going to cheat in the competition.

m.d: An overcoat is a heavy garment that is worn over other clothes to protect you from cold or weather.
If you overcoat something, you apply an exterior coating to.
Overalls are pants with a front that comes up to your chest and straps over your shoulders.
Overalls are a loose protective trouser and shirt in one.
If you overreact, you react too intensely to something.
m.e: Please try not to overreact if she drives badly when she is first learning.

m.d: An overkill is the destructive capacity the exceeds the amount of what is needed.
An overkill is an unnecessary excess of whatever is needed to achieve a goal.
If something overflows, it submerges the brim of the container.
m.e: The bucket is now wider so the event of an overflow is unlikely.

m.d: The act of overlapping. The amount that two things overlap on each other.
m.e: More overlap keeps the rain out better, but needs more shingles to cover the roof.

m.d: Something overlaps on another thing if part of it is on top of, or at the same time as, the other thing.
m.e: The shingles of a roof need to overlap to keep rain out.

m.d: If you are overwhelmed by a feeling, you feel it very strongly, and you cannot deal with it.
If a problem overwhelms you, it's too difficult for you to solve or deal with.
If one army overwhelms another, they completely defeat them.
m.e: The team was able to overwhelm their opponents and win first place

m.d: If you are overprotective, you give too much protection to a person, usually a child.
A reproductive organ found in female bodies that produces eggs.
To overcook means to cook for a longer duration or at a higher temperature.
m.e: Overcooking foods can lead to a loss of nutrients in them.

m.d: If something overjoys you, it provides you with great joy or delight.
If you overrule someone, you change a decision they made by using your superior power.
m.e: We had planned to stop, but the boss overruled us.

m.d: An oversize is the increased size of a bore when it is rebored.
If something is oversize, its size is larger than normal.
m.e: The oversized luggage does not fit into the trunk of the car.

m.d: To oversize something, you cover it with gluey matter.
If something is oversize, it is larger than normal; excessively large.
If you oversleep, you sleep longer than what you wanted.
m.e: I overslept and was late for school.

m.d: An overturn is the act of turning over or upside-down.
If you overturn something, you tip it to its side so that it is on its side or upside down.
If you overturn a decision, you reverse or invalidate it.
If you overwork someone, you make them work too hard.
If you overwork, you work too hard.
